prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, hint] Starter Path Recommendation Quiz Hint: Adds explicit guidance explaining the time commitment and outcome of each path option. (why: Choose path has an unusually high mean duration of 514s (median 8s), showing users get stuck analyzing choices.)
1: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Interactive Arrival Sound Alert: Triggers a celebratory sound effect and desktop completion badge when pet setup completes. (why: Finish stage mean duration is 5815s with only 64.8% completing, suggesting users walk away or miss when setup finishes.)
2: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Pet Behavior Teaser During Waiting: Displays interactive pet animations and behavior trivia on the waiting screen while desktop assets compile. (why: Home waiting screen median time is 201s (mean 2336s). Keeping users engaged reduces drop-off during background generation.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery & Safe Sync Guarantee: Adds copy clarifying how sign-in preserves desktop pet progress, state, and custom items across app restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)

scores.note: High mean time indicates decision paralysis, but median is short and no support tickets mention it.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users with massive mean delay; alerts help draw users back.
Long compilation wait times degrade home step completion, but interactive teasers require net-new assets.
Both support emails (largest category) and funnel drop-off highlight sign-in pet sync anxieties; simple copy fix.
